job.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Core UX
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer - Core UX based in Netherlands.

This remote role offers the opportunity to improve the everyday experience of users working with sophisticated, business-critical software. As part of a Core UX-focused engineering team, you will refine existing functionality, strengthen consistency, and deliver polished, high-performing interfaces. You will combine strong frontend expertise with full-stack engineering skills to solve challenging product and technical problems. Working alongside full-stack, data, ML, and DevOps engineers, you will contribute to scalable solutions within a highly collaborative global environment. The role provides substantial ownership, with individual contributions directly influencing both product quality and business outcomes. It is particularly suited to an engineer who enjoys iterative improvement, experimentation, and delivering a premium user experience.

Accountabilities


Refine and improve existing product functionality with a strong focus on usability, consistency, responsiveness, performance, and visual quality.
Build and maintain scalable full-stack solutions that support reliable, high-quality user experiences.
Implement thoughtful frontend interactions and layouts while ensuring a cohesive experience across the product.
Collaborate with full-stack, data, machine learning, and DevOps engineers to develop and evolve product capabilities.
Contribute to system design, debugging, performance improvements, and technical problem-solving across the application stack.
Take full ownership of assigned projects, driving initiatives from initial concept through implementation and completion with minimal oversight.
Experiment with different technical and product approaches, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly to improve functionality and user impact.
Communicate proactively with stakeholders, surface blockers, ask relevant questions, and provide clear updates throughout projects.
Contribute to scalable cloud-based architectures, asynchronous workflows, and reliable backend solutions as the product continues to grow.


Requirements


5+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally with a strong track record of improving and polishing product functionality and user experiences.
Strong engineering fundamentals in system design, debugging, architecture, and problem-solving.
Professional experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React.
Strong programming experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python; candidates with strong object-oriented programming backgrounds may also be considered.
Experience with cloud and serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda and EC2, as well as asynchronous workflows and cloud-based environments.
Comfortable working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL.
Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to independently drive projects through completion and maintain high standards of quality.
Proactive and transparent communication style, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed international environment.
Comfortable experimenting, testing ideas, measuring results, and iterating rapidly on complex or unfamiliar problems.
Experience with LLMs, generative AI, or distributed systems is a plus.
Ability to work from a European country where you are authorized to work; the engagement is offered on a B2B or contractor basis, with no visa sponsorship available.


Benefits


Salary range of approximately $80,000–$165,000 USD, depending on experience, performance, and geographic location.
Significant equity options package.
20 days of paid time off per year.
Opportunity to work with an ambitious, international, and multidisciplinary team on technology addressing a major global industry.
Global team offsites and opportunities to connect with colleagues internationally.
Phone reimbursement.
Gym reimbursement.
Student stipend.
High level of ownership and the opportunity to make a substantial impact within a growth-stage environment.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
job.description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Senior Software Engineer: Applied AI

Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.

We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving - with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.

This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.

What You'll Do

You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:


Designing and shipping end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work - customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more. 
Crossing organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission. 
Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity. 
Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions. 


You Should Have


5+ years of software engineering experience; you've built with LLMs extensively - whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself. 
Strong product instincts: you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec. 
LLM fluency: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos. 
Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js - you can own a feature end-to-end. 
An entrepreneurial drive: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do. 
Excellent communication: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself. 
An audacious appetite for impact: you're not here to maintain - you're here to change how global trade works. 


Nice to Have


Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.). 
Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications. 


How We Work


We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together. 
We have the latest hardware and software - including frontier AI models on day one. 
We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best. 
Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs. 


Why This Role Is Special


Your work is visible: This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction. 
Real stakes: thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact. 
Full ownership: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours. 
You're early: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet - you'll help write it. 


What's in it for you?


An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment 
Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment. 
Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
A defined pension contribution scheme
Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success. 
Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. 


Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

You will join a cross-functional engineering team building the next generation of personalized e-commerce discovery experiences across multiple marketing channels.

Your focus will be on developing a customer-facing dashboard that enables businesses to manage and optimize personalized marketing campaigns.

You will work across the frontend and backend, building scalable features with TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI.

The platform supports high-volume, real-time traffic of up to 10,000 requests per second, making scalability and reliability central to the role.

You will collaborate closely with engineers and technical and non-technical stakeholders to turn ideas into useful, production-ready functionality.

The role offers opportunities to influence product direction, solve challenging engineering problems, and contribute to a rapidly evolving platform.

You will work in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, curiosity, empathy, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Accountabilities


Develop and deliver customer dashboard features using TypeScript and React, integrating with backend services built with Python and FastAPI.
Build, maintain, and improve scalable web application functionality designed to support high-volume, real-time e-commerce experiences.
Participate in technical brainstorming and product discussions to identify and shape new features, tools, and capabilities.

job.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
job.description:
Are you a Full Stack Engineer who sees AI as more than simply calling an LLM API?

For a large enterprise organisation in the Netherlands, we are looking for a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer to join a small engineering team building an innovative AI-native application from the ground up.

The goal is to develop an agentic application that can take business and technical requirements, gather the right context, identify missing or conflicting information, generate technical artifacts and code, and validate the output against requirements and organisational controls.

This is an early-stage initiative, so we are looking for someone with a genuine builder mindset. The ambition is to demonstrate a working and valuable application within approximately 6–9 months.




What will you be building?

The application will automate parts of the data-engineering lifecycle by combining structured information such as data contracts, schemas, standards and control definitions with unstructured business and technical requirements.

You will help build the complete application around the AI models, including:

Designing human-AI interactions for gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity and reviewing generated outputs.
Building the full web application across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations and application services.
Engineering AI harnesses and orchestration layers that connect models with enterprise context, tools, execution environments and validation mechanisms.
Developing iterative AI workflows where the system can generate, test, validate, correct and explain its outputs.
Building mechanisms for context retrieval and context engineering across enterprise data sources.
Integrating automated testing, CI/CD feedback, data-quality checks and organisational controls into AI workflows.
Maintaining traceability between requirements, retrieved context, generated artifacts, validation results and user decisions.
Contributing to security, observability, maintainability and production readiness.
Working closely with architecture, data engineering and platform specialists.




The profile we are looking for

We are looking for a medior-senior to senior engineer, ideally with 5+ years of software engineering experience, who enjoys working across the full technology stack.

You are not purely a frontend or backend engineer. You are comfortable moving between application architecture, Python services, React interfaces, AI orchestration and cloud infrastructure.




Ideally you bring:

Strong Python development experience.
Solid React / modern frontend development experience.
Experience building enterprise web applications from scratch.
Strong API, backend and application-service development experience.
Experience with LLMs, Agentic AI or AI orchestration.
Understanding of AI harnesses, tool calling, context retrieval and validation loops.
Experience designing effective human-AI interactions and UX.
Experience with Azure.
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and/or Bicep.
Experience with CI/CD and modern software-engineering practices.
Understanding of security, privacy, IAM, auditability and operational reliability in enterprise environments.




Experience in any of the following would be highly valuable:

AI-assisted code generation.
Agentic workflows or multi-step AI systems.
Evaluation frameworks, guardrails or AI quality mechanisms.
Secure execution and validation of AI-generated code.
RAG / context engineering.
Requirements traceability.
Policy-as-code or automated control validation.
Data contracts, schemas, metadata or data-product concepts.
GitHub Copilot or comparable AI-assisted development tools.
Building products in a regulated enterprise environment.




The work will roughly combine:

30% AI / Agentic Engineering

30% Frontend / UX

40% Backend / Platform Engineering

There is therefore a slight emphasis on backend engineering, but you should be comfortable contributing across the entire application.




How you work

We are looking for someone with an entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset.

The team operates within a large enterprise organisation, but the project itself needs the pace and ownership of a startup. You should therefore be comfortable navigating enterprise requirements while still finding practical ways to move quickly.

You enjoy working with incomplete requirements, asking the right questions and turning ambiguity into working software. You understand that the AI model itself is only one part of an AI-native product and that reliable outcomes depend on context, orchestration, UX, validation, controls and feedback loops.




The team

You will join a small senior engineering squad supported by a Product Manager. The team is being built around complementary engineering strengths, so collaboration and shared technical decision-making are important.




This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a people-management position. It is a particularly interesting opportunity for an engineer who wants to move beyond traditional Full Stack development and help build a production-grade Agentic AI application from its earliest stages.

job.title: Gomocha FSP Software Engineer
job.description:
Gomocha - Software Engineer

Gomocha is the field service platform for forward-thinking field service operators. Through a combination of service demand management, dispatch scheduling, technician enablement, and analytics—not to mention white glove service—Gomocha uncovers hidden efficiencies, matching skill with demand, so your field workers deliver an exceptional customer service experience time after time. 




Our platform, Gomocha FSP, is a SaaS (Software as a Service) field service management solution that is flexible, easy to implement, innovative, fast-growing, agile, and easy to configure (no coding necessary) that is tailored to tackle company-specific field service challenges and ensure compliance with industry rules and regulations. 




With offices on the East and West Coasts of the United States and in the Netherlands, Gomocha has supported the global field services community for more than thirty years. For more information, visit our website, www.gomocha.com.




Gomocha is looking for dynamic, innovative individuals who are outgoing and possess a unique approach to problem-solving. We value flexibility and are excited to welcome like-minded individuals to join our team. 




As a Gomocha Software Engineer, you will first learn about our platform and its capabilities; you will soon discover that our configuration capability provides a lifetime of learning opportunities. An annual review will evaluate progress and stimulate learning opportunities with career growth. The only constant factor we strive for in the Gomocha team is learning.




Your Contribution to our Team

A Software Engineer focuses on our customers’ overall success by ensuring our platform’s continuous improvement, usability, and seamless integration. Through technical excellence, customer-centric innovation, and collaborative teamwork, to play a pivotal role in fostering strong partnerships, being a team player, and delivering value throughout our customers' lifecycle. Your day to day revolves around designing, developing, and maintaining the platform’s core infrastructure, integrations, and features. 




Gomocha FSP Software Engineer (Full-time, Utrecht + Remote)

Build the Future of Field Service Management with Cutting-Edge Tech




At Gomocha, we’re redefining how field service organizations operate. Our Field Service Platform (FSP) helps global enterprises orchestrate their operations — from dispatch scheduling and mobile enablement to analytics and compliance — all powered by modern technology and AI-assisted development.




We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Utrecht-based platform team, building the next generation of our enterprise-grade SaaS solution.




Why This Role Matters

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems — you’ll be building scalable, cloud-native architecture with the latest technologies. You’ll tackle real engineering challenges: from designing new microservices to improving real-time data sync and integrating external systems. If you see AI tools like Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude Code as productivity amplifiers, not shortcuts — you’ll fit right in.




What You’ll Work With

Backend:

 .NET 8 / C# with ASP.NET Core, FastEndpoints, RabbitMQ, Entity Framework Core & Dapper

SQL Server (including spatial data support)




Frontend:

React 17 + TypeScript with Kendo React

Modern tooling (React Query, Webpack 5, TailwindCSS, Styled Components)




Infrastructure & DevOps:

Azure Pipelines CI/CD with automated versioning

Playwright for end-to-end and integration testing




Mobile:

- Cross-platform Cordova (Android, iOS, UWP)

- Offline-first architecture with secure synchronization

  

What Makes This Role Unique

AI-First Development Culture; We encourage engineers to use AI tools daily. If AI helps you write better tests, refactor faster, or explore new patterns use it. We focus on outcomes over keystrokes.




Real Engineering Challenges

- Design and implement new microservices and APIs

- Optimize synchronization across distributed clients

- Scale high-load enterprise services

- Modernize existing components with maintainable architecture

- Integrate with third-party systems (ERP, payments, communication)




Modern Development Practices

- Documentation-driven development (Docusaurus)

- Automated testing (unit, integration, E2E)

- Code reviews, pair programming, and architectural collaboration




Growth & Autonomy

- Full ownership of features (from database to UI)

- Influence technical decisions and product direction

- Collaborate with a skilled, motivated team

- Learn continuously and share knowledge with peers




What We’re Looking For




Must-have:




- Strong experience with C# / .NET Core (ASP.NET Core, Web API)

- Understanding of REST API design and microservices principles

- Experience with SQL databases (preferably SQL Server)

- Familiarity with Git, Docker, Azure

- Mobile (iOS/Android/Cordova) development knowledge

- Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently

- Fluent English (written and spoken)

   Nice-to-have:




- Solid React + TypeScript frontend skills

- Dutch language skills (for team collaboration)

- Entity Framework Core, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus

- SignalR / WebSockets experience

- CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)

- Experience with Kendo UI or Material-UI

   Personality fit:




- Results-driven: You care about delivering value, not hours logged

- AI-empowered: You use AI tools to accelerate development thoughtfully

- Passion for the Craft

- Pragmatic: You balance innovation with reliability

- Communicative: You explain your reasoning clearly and collaborate effectively

  




The Practical Details

- Location: Utrecht office + Remote (hybrid model)

- Schedule: Full-time

- 3 days/week in-office (collaboration, design, pair programming)

- 2 days/week remote (focused work)

- Work style: Flexible hours focused on results

- Team: Small, experienced, highly collaborative

- Contract: Competitive salary, hybrid flexibility, benefits based on experience




Why Join Gomocha

✅ Work with a modern tech stack actively updated to the latest versions

✅ Meaningful impact: Your code powers real businesses in the field

✅ Technical freedom: Choose the best tools (including AI) for the job

✅ Ownership culture: Follow your features from design to deployment

✅ Learning budget: We invest in your professional growth

✅ Flexible hybrid work: The best of both worlds — collaboration + focus




How to Apply

If this sounds like you, apply with your CV and a short note about:

1. A technical challenge you’re proud of solving

2. How you use AI tools in your development process

3. What excites you about field service management software




We value diversity and welcome applications from developers of all backgrounds.




Gomocha Values




Open Culture: At Gomocha, transparency is key. We foster a culture where everyone feels free to express their thoughts and ideas. We celebrate our diverse personalities and beliefs, keeping an open mind to learn and grow personally and professionally. 




Constructive Feedback Intention: We value constructive feedback as a tool for growth. Feedback at Gomocha is never unreasonable or personal; it aims to enhance the quality of our customers’ service experience. We encourage open communication to improve together continuously. 




Proactive Service: Gomocha employees are expected to be proactive in helping, recognizing that not all requests for help are explicit. Our commitment to exceptional service extends to our customers and our internal team. We strive to deliver white glove service in every interaction.




Learning opportunities: We provide many opportunities to expand your knowledge of the Field Service industry, Microsoft technology, and Gomocha FSP configuration options— access online courses to enhance your skills and share your knowledge to further your learning journey.




Improvement suggestions: We encourage team members to document and share ideas for improvement. Provide detailed information to facilitate efficient assessment by leadership. Advocate for your suggestions, promoting the business case until implementation.

job.title: Werkstudent Software Engineer
job.description:

Locatie: Hybride met standplaats in Amsterdam
Uren per week: 16+
Salaris: Op basis van uurloon
Niveau: WO Bachelor/Master
Dienstverband: 0-uren contract, met uitzicht op een plek als junior in ons team nadat je afstudeert.
Vloeiend Nederlands is een vereiste




Wil jij bouwen aan productieklare AI-gedreven software die maatschappelijke impact maakt, en de koers te bepalen waarmee AI wordt ingezet in onze maatschappij? Heb je een sterke achtergrond in software engineering en een passie voor AI? Bij NextHuman zoeken we een Werkstudent Software Engineer die helpt bij het ontwikkelen van robuuste en schaalbare applicaties waarin foundation models en machine learning een cruciale rol spelen.




Wat ga je doen?




Als Werkstudent Software Engineer ontwikkel je mee aan full-stack webapplicaties waarin AI-modellen worden geïntegreerd. Je leert van het team hoe wij met clean architectuur en ons design framework hoge kwaliteit software maken voor de onze klanten in het sociaal domein. Je werkt samen met AI-consultants en klanten om technische oplossingen te bouwen die niet alleen krachtig, maar ook goed te adopteren zijn in de praktijk. Door de diversiteit aan opdrachten van gemeentes en NGO's tot woningcorporaties en werkontwikkelbedrijven, is je werk afwisselend en maak je een brede maatschappelijke impact.




Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:




Software Engineering (focus)




Ontwikkelen en implementeren van full-stack AI-geïntegreerde applicaties (Python, Next.js/React, FastAPI, Azure infrastructuur).
Waarborgen van stabiliteit en schaalbaarheid van softwareproducten, inclusief monitoring en observability.
Monitoren van onze data pipelines.




ML & AI Engineering




Werken met AI/ML-integraties (foundation models) in onze software.
Data engineering en data science om feature engineering te doen met onze productiedata.
Custom ML modellen trainen en opzetten van model monitoring & retraining pipelines (MLflow & Azure).
Werken met tools zoals MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow en feature stores.




Samenwerking & Strategie




Analyseren van processen bij klanten om inefficiënties en risico’s aan te pakken met data-gedreven en ML-oplossingen. 
Samenwerken met onze implementatiecollega’s en product owners om de oplossingen te verbeteren en effectief te laten landen.
Delen van kennis met collega’s en bijdragen aan de technische groei van het team.




Wie zijn wij? 




NextHuman is een snelgroeiend AI consultancy- en softwarebedrijf gevestigd in Amsterdam. Wij helpen organisaties om AI verantwoord en effectief in te zetten in hun dagelijkse praktijk.




We werken veel met organisaties binnen het sociaal domein, waaronder gemeenten en sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven. Met het NextHuman platform ondersteunen we professionals bij maatschappelijke vraagstukken rondom onder andere werk, ontwikkeling en participatie. Onze ambitie is om AI op een praktische, verantwoorde en mensgerichte manier onderdeel te maken van hun dagelijkse werk.




Bij NextHuman combineren we strategie, technologie en implementatie. We ontwikkelen ons platform in nauwe samenwerking met de organisaties en professionals die ermee werken. Daardoor zijn de lijnen tussen klant en product kort: wat we in de praktijk leren, vormt direct input voor de verdere ontwikkeling van het NextHuman-platform.




In ons team krijg je de kans om volledig mee te draaien in een jonge en ondernemende organisatie en direct maatschappelijke impact te maken.




Wie ben jij?




Je studeert Computer Science of iets vergelijkbaars.
Ervaring met end-to-end softwareontwikkeling, inclusief frontend (Next.js/React), backend (FastAPI), cloud infrastructuur (terraform, Azure) en containerization (Docker).
Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en monitoring tools (Azure Log Analytics & Monitor, Datadog).
Bekend met Data Science & MLOps.
Kan goed overweg met Cursor of vergelijkbare IDEs.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een teamspeler.
Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum omgeving.




Wat bieden we jou?

Hybride werken, met ons kantoor in Amsterdam als standplaats.
De kans om als volwaardig teamlid mee te bouwen aan productieklare AI-software die dagelijks in de praktijk wordt gebruikt.
Veel ruimte om je technisch te ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van software engineering, AI/ML, cloud en MLOps.
Veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief binnen een hecht en ondernemend team.
De kans om in korte tijd veel ervaring op te doen met AI, softwareontwikkeling en productontwikkeling en direct te leren van ervaren collega’s.
Werken aan technologie en projecten met directe maatschappelijke impact.
Uitzicht op een plek als junior Software Engineer na je afstuderen.




Solliciteren?




Interesse? Stuur je CV en motivatie naar info@nexthuman.nl.

Nikki Wesselius

job.title: Senior Front-end Developer (Vue.Js) - Part-Time
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-end Developer (Vue.js) - Part-Time based in Netherlands.

This fully remote, long-term opportunity is designed for a senior frontend developer who wants meaningful ownership within a part-time schedule. Working 24 hours per week across approximately three days, you will build and maintain business-critical B2B applications with a strong focus on Vue.js. You will translate complex commercial and logistical processes into intuitive, reliable user experiences. The role involves close collaboration with backend engineers, Product and Design stakeholders, and international teams operating across multiple time zones. You will also contribute to frontend architecture, shared component libraries, design systems, performance, and accessibility. With primarily CET-based working hours and a distributed environment, the position offers flexibility while maintaining strong collaboration and technical impact.

Accountabilities


Design, develop, maintain, and improve robust Vue.js applications supporting complex B2B workflows.
Translate commercial and logistical business requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable user interfaces.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers on REST APIs, API contracts, and integration requirements within a Laravel-based environment.
Partner with Product and Design stakeholders to turn requirements and designs into polished digital experiences.
Contribute to the development and evolution of shared component libraries and design system standards.
Ensure frontend applications meet high standards for performance, accessibility, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility.
Write maintainable, scalable, well-tested code and contribute to frontend testing practices.
Communicate proactively and clearly in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders across international teams.
Take ownership of assigned work and contribute to the ongoing reliability, quality, and evolution of the platform.


Requirements


Senior-level professional experience developing frontend applications with strong expertise in Vue.js, ideally covering both Vue 2 and Vue 3 and the Composition API.
Strong command of modern JavaScript, CSS, component architecture, and frontend development principles.
Solid understanding of REST API consumption and state management in larger-scale applications.
Comfortable working alongside a Laravel backend; hands-on PHP experience is a plus.
Experience with frontend testing, build tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and frontend performance optimization.
Proven experience working effectively within distributed and international teams across multiple time zones.
Professional-level English, both written and spoken, with the ability to lead discussions, create documentation, and explain complex technical topics confidently.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical challenges to non-technical audiences.
Proactive, dependable, ownership-oriented mindset with strong attention to quality and reliability.
Familiarity with cloud-based development environments, Docker, Kubernetes, or scalable application architectures is beneficial.


Benefits


Long-term, part-time engagement of 24 hours per week, ideally spread across three working days.
Fully remote working arrangement within Europe.
Opportunity to work on a business-critical platform with significant international reach.
Collaboration with an experienced, globally distributed product and engineering team.
Primarily CET-based working hours with flexibility for occasional international collaboration.
Opportunity to influence frontend architecture, development standards, and the evolution of the design system.
High level of ownership and direct collaboration with key stakeholders.
Modern technical environment with established development, testing, and delivery practices.
Long-term stability and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution within an international product environment.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
About the Role







Senior Data Engineer – Role description







Job Description As Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build and evolve secure, scalable and governed data solutions that enable FMCC to deliver reliable controls, regulatory outcomes and actionable client, income, commercial, or control insights. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end ownership, translating business and regulatory needs into robust data models, pipelines and business intelligence solutions. You will be a senior technical contributor across strategic data, BI and AI initiatives. You are expected to be visible, pragmatic and closely involved in delivery, from solution design and engineering through testing, deployment and production support. You will raise engineering standards, anticipate risks, provide clear technical direction and help the team deliver consistently without surprises. As a senior member of the team, you will share best practices, coach colleagues and contribute to a solution-focused, collaborative culture anchored in the Orange Code behaviours. This role reports functionally into the Data Domain Area lead in Amsterdam and hierarchically to the Change Lead. As an Senior Data Engineer, you play a pivotal role in driving data engineering, data insights, BI and AI projects through empowered teams and strategic alignment.







Responsibilities







Your key responsibilities include:







Own the end-to-end design, development and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and data products, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration and consumption.
Translate business, control and regulatory requirements into robust technical designs, governed data models and fit-for-purpose BI solutions.
Design and implement reliable ETL and ELT processes for batch and, where relevant, streaming workloads, with appropriate controls for data quality, lineage and traceability.
Lead technical solution design and provide reusable blueprints that improve scalability, maintainability, client outcomes and regulatory compliance.
Build engineering quality into delivery through automated testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, monitoring, observability and clear operational ownership.
Own the deployment lifecycle for new and changed data models and BI solutions across test, acceptance and production environments.
Perform impact assessments and work with cross-functional partners to evaluate business, operational, process and technology implications before implementation.
Partner with analysts, data scientists, product owners, process experts and stakeholders to prioritize work, manage dependencies and deliver against the roadmap.
Ensure technical documentation, requirements, design decisions, controls and support procedures are complete, current and endorsed by relevant stakeholders.
Drive timely enrichment and optimization of FMCC data required for new regulations, control processes and Process and Transaction Monitoring solutions.
Explore how FMCC data capabilities can support advanced analytics and future AI use cases, including responsible use of generative AI.
Coach and mentor engineers, promote knowledge sharing and challenge the team to improve engineering practices, resilience and delivery discipline.
Contribute actively to Agile ceremonies and foster transparent planning, early escalation and fact-based decision-making.
Act as the primary bridge between FMCC business teams, Change, BAU, Architecture and BIDS, ensuring data capabilities are aligned with strategic business priorities and operational needs.
Drive the integration of data capabilities across FMCC by promoting shared standards, reusable solutions, cross-functional collaboration and early involvement of data expertise in strategic initiatives.
Represent FMCC Data in cross-domain forums, architecture discussions and strategic initiatives across Wholesale Banking.







You are not only expected to build solutions, but also to shape how FMCC designs, governs and operates its data engineering capabilities.







BI experience in Power BI, Cognos, Tableau, Looker is preferable.







Qualifications







Minimum of 8 years working experience in the technical data or cloud role.
At least 8 years of proven track record in delivering Data, BI or IT solutions, preferably with an Agile Way of Working.







Required Skills







Technical skills we are looking for:







At least 8 years of relevant experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, data analytics or a closely related technical field.
Proven hands-on experience designing and building complex production-grade data pipelines using ETL and ETL patterns.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with practical experience using PySpark for distributed data processing.
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, and working knowledge of Azure or AWS.
Strong understanding of data modelling, normalization and denormalization, data integration, data lakes and data warehouses.
Experience with relational and non-relational data stores, including technologies such as MS SQL, Hive and dbt, plus object storage such as Amazon S3.
Experience with containerization, orchestration and automated delivery tooling, including Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience managing and optimizing distributed systems and clusters for large-scale batch processing.
Good command of software engineering practices, including modular design, testing, code review, documentation, security and production support.







Preferred Skills







Soft skills we are looking for:







Curious mindset; you are collaborative and passionate about helping others to grow and improve.
Proactive, hands on - can-do mentality, on top of your delivery (no surprises) and positive mind-set.
The ability to facilitate decision-making to drive complex design issues to a conclusion.
Team player with good communication skills (Fluent in English) and experienced in working in an international environment.
Strong organisational sensitivity: ability to understand and consider the underlying issues, opportunities and dynamics of an international organisation with multiple functional and hierarchical lines, dealing with multiple (sometimes conflicting) interests.
